artworks.title: Achilles and Telephus
artworks.description: Spranger's oracle fulfilled — he who wounded shall heal, when rust from the Pelian spear cured the Mysian king.

artworks.title: Telephus Frieze (detail)
artworks.description: The Pergamon frieze — Telephus' battles in Teuthrania when the Greeks mistook Mysia for Troy.
